corrections.why: The list gives the tower's GFC number as 022 (gfc-022) with no 'US' part; a human should confirm the register format.

notes_for_editor: Very thin: one 2016 map entry (tnlandforms GA319) and nothing else found. The name 'leah' is the map compiler's own label (entries 73 and above are named by the compiler), not a documented name. Searches for a Leah or Harlem Columbia County fire tower found nothing relevant. The map's gfc-022 code is consistent with the record's GFC register but the record's 'US' prefix is not in the source. Elevation is given with no unit; read as feet (record 152.4 m). Not found in the cached NHLR Georgia index. Nothing found on build date, staffing, fate or access.
